_comment: East Riding facts the spreadsheet does not hold, kept from the hand-extracted east-riding.json: the design code details, its place types (with their national area types, used by the filters and the "Not sure what I am looking for?" questions) and its development types (with their keys and Table 1 descriptions). Used by scripts/csv-to-json.js.

design-code.name: East Riding Design Code
design-code.description: The East Riding Design Code has been prepared to clarify design expectations and improve the quality of new development across the whole of the East Riding of Yorkshire.
design-code.vision: Green, inclusive and distinctive places, which connect landscape, people, place and nature. New development in the East Riding will celebrate the diversity of the built and natural environment and its heritage to create healthy and sustainable places for the communities of today and tomorrow.
design-code.coverage: The whole of the East Riding of Yorkshire
design-code.credits: Illustrations by Harper Perry Ltd; Illustrations by Joseph Cox, FORM Studio

development-types.name: Householder Development
development-types.description: Extensions, or minor works requiring planning permission, to a single existing housing unit.
development-types.notes: Development types come from Table 1 in Chapter 1, included so that rule references resolve. Names are written in sentence case here; Table 1 prints them in capitals (for example "H HOUSEHOLDER DEVELOPMENT").

development-types.name: 1-2 Units
development-types.description: New housing units. Please note a seperate checklist exists for residential conversions.
development-types.notes: Table 1 gives one shared description for codes 1, 2 and 3. "seperate" is as printed.

development-types.name: 3-9 Units
development-types.description: New housing units. Please note a seperate checklist exists for residential conversions.
development-types.notes: Table 1 gives one shared description for codes 1, 2 and 3. "seperate" is as printed.

development-types.name: 10+ Units
development-types.description: New housing units. Please note a seperate checklist exists for residential conversions.
development-types.notes: Table 1 gives one shared description for codes 1, 2 and 3. "seperate" is as printed.

development-types.name: Mixed Use
development-types.description: Residential and commercial mixed use sites.

development-types.name: Flats
development-types.description: New-build flats, or the conversion of existing premises to flats where requiring planning permission.

development-types.name: Agricultural
development-types.description: New-build development on agricultural land (not including changes of use to non-agricultural development or development not supporting an existing agricultural function).

development-types.name: Industrial, Storage and Distribution (B Class Uses)
development-types.description: Development intended for B Class uses including general industrial and storage and distribution.

development-types.name: Commercial
development-types.description: All forms of new-build development intended for commercial use, including offices, bars and eateries, and community spaces.

development-types.name: Advertisement Consent
development-types.notes: Not in Table 1. Name from Table 2 (Form 17 Advertisement Consent); Appendix D heads the column "Adv Consent". No description is given. No Chapter 3 item applies to it.
